exact.Medienserver eingeschaltet (startet auch: Media server switched on (also starts after a restart)

exact.Darf oben in der Kopfzeile der ShareOS-O: May show a short state at the top of the ShareOS interface (e.g. “connected”) – only to the user who opened the app; it disappears by itself after at most 10 minutes.
exact.Weder ein persönlicher Ordner noch eine: Neither a personal folder nor a share for you.
exact.Dateien: persönlicher Ordner und Freigab: Files: personal folder and shares (by permissions) in the file browser and in apps
exact.Darf die Box mit Tailscale verbinden, an: May connect the box with Tailscale, sign in and out and see the devices of the tailnet – this affects the network of the whole box, so admins only.
exact.Öffnet sich jetzt in einem eigenen Fenst: Now opens in its own window.

exact.App-Leiste „FAV APPS“ anzeigen (nur für: Show the “FAV APPS” app bar (just for you)
exact.Mit dem Stern auf einer App-Kachel wird: The star on an app tile makes it a favourite. The bar sits above “Status” in the overview and above the installed apps.
exact.Namen unter den Symbolen zeigen (aus: nu: Show names below the icons (off: icons only)
exact.Darf die Werte der Box lesen (CPU, Arbei: May read the box's values (CPU, memory, temperature, fan, drives, processes) and end processes ShareOS does not need – administrators only.
exact.Darf von der Box aus prüfen, ob Geräte u: May check from the box whether devices and services on the network are reachable (ping, port, HTTP/HTTPS) – administrators only.
exact.Darf die Docker-Hosts verwalten, die der: May manage the Docker hosts the administrator adds and there view, start, stop and restart containers and read their logs (Docker API) – administrators only.
exact.Darf von der Box aus Tuya-Geräte im Heim: May find Tuya devices on the home network from the box, read their state and switch them (locally, without the cloud) – administrators only.
exact.Langtest am 1. jedes Monats (3:30 Uhr): Long test on the 1st of every month (3:30 am)
exact.Daten sichern und die Platte bald tausch: Back up the data and replace the disk soon.
exact.SMART der Platten und SSDs: SMART of the disks and SSDs
exact.SMART noch nicht gelesen. Beim Lesen wac: SMART not read yet. Reading wakes the disk up.

This disk gives no SMART values.
exact.Dieser USB-Adapter reicht keine SMART-We: This USB adapter does not pass on SMART values.

exact.Die Platte meldet selbst einen Ausfall,: The disk itself reports a failure, a value is below the manufacturer's threshold, a self-test failed, more than 100 reallocated or more than 10 pending sectors, an SSD with 10 % life or less, 60 °C and above.
exact.Einzelne umgelagerte, schwebende oder ni: A few reallocated, pending or unreadable sectors, transfer errors, entries in the error log, an SSD with 20 % life or less, from 55 °C.
exact.Der Kurztest prüft die Elektronik und ei: The short test checks the electronics and part of the surface, the long test reads the whole disk (many hours for large disks; the disk stays awake meanwhile). The result shows here and as a message when something is wrong.
exact.Gelöschtes im Dateibrowser erst in den P: Put what is deleted in the file browser into the trash first
exact.Jeder Ordner hat seinen eigenen Papierko: Every folder has its own trash: the personal folder, each share, each drive. It lies on the same disk and counts towards the storage limit. It applies to the file browser of this interface – what is deleted over SMB from a PC or in apps is gone at once; for that there are the snapshots.
exact.Zu wenig Platz auf dem Ziel – nichts kop: Not enough space on the target – nothing copied.

exact.Darf Meldungen über die Benachrichtigung: May send messages through the box's notifications (web interface, e-mail, push) – at most 20 an hour, with the app's name in front; in the browser for administrators only.
exact.Fenster blockiert – Pop-ups für diese Se: Window blocked – allow pop-ups for this page.
exact.Das Terminal läuft in einem eigenen Fens: The terminal runs in its own window.
exact.Die Sitzung gilt für ein Fenster und end: The session is for one window and ends when it is closed – a window of its own gets a new session. Careful: commands as root take effect at once and without a trash.
exact.AUS- UND EINSCHALTEN NACH ZEITPLAN: SWITCH OFF AND ON BY SCHEDULE
exact.Leere Felder: an diesem Tag nichts. Ausg: Empty fields: nothing on that day. The box shuts down cleanly (as with the button); while a storage job runs (e.g. a RAID rebuild) it stays on. To switch on, ShareOS sets the wake-up time of the device controller – do not unplug it.
exact.Diese Box kann sich nicht selbst einscha: This box cannot switch itself on (no wake-up function) – only switching off by schedule works. Switch it on with the power button.
exact.Schneller mit Windows 11, das jede Verbi: Faster with Windows 11, which signs every connection: the signature of SMB 2.1 costs this box about half the computing time of the one of SMB 3 (measured about 9–14 instead of 4–10 MB/s when writing). Without signing about 35 MB/s are possible. In exchange there is no SMB 3: no encryption, no multichannel. Open connections are dropped when this is changed.
exact.Der Assistent löscht die ausgewählten Pl: The wizard erases the selected disks and sets them up again. Single disks can also be formatted directly at the disk under “Drives”. Disks with data (e.g. from Alt-F or the D-Link firmware) are added without erasing with “… take over” at the disk.
exact.Nur für Geräte, die mit SMB 3 nicht zure: Only for devices that have trouble with SMB 3. The signature Windows 11 requires on every connection is computed by the crypto engine of the box with SMB 3 (measured about 19–23 MB/s when writing, about 35 without signing); SMB 2.1 computes it on the processor (about 9–14 MB/s) and has no encryption and no multichannel. Open connections are dropped when this is changed.
exact.Der Zeitplan ist aus – die eingetragenen: The schedule is off – the times entered only apply with the tick at “Switch the schedule on”.
Switching on afterwards only at the device.

^Die Änderung gilt sofort\. Die Box wartet dann (\d+) Sekunden auf eine Bestätigung von der neuen Adresse – kommt keine, stellt sie die bisherigen Einstellungen wieder her\. So sperrst du dich nicht aus\.$
The change takes effect at once. The box then waits $1 seconds for a confirmation from the new address – if none comes, it restores the previous settings. So you cannot lock yourself out.

– without confirmation the box returns to the old ones in $1 s.

The box gets its address from the router. Afterwards it may be reachable under a different address (look it up in the router). If the change is not confirmed on the box within $1 seconds, the previous settings apply again.

waiting for the box ($1 s) – not reachable? Look up the new address in the router and log in there.
